# Reporting a security issue

Please report suspected vulnerabilities through the [Feedback form](https://toolbraid.pages.dev/feedback/), not a public GitHub issue. Messages are not published as issues, and the publisher's email is not exposed. The form is handled by a third-party provider; send a minimal, sanitized report, not sensitive attachments.

Include the affected ToolBraid version, browser/Windows version, a short description of the impact, and safe reproduction steps using test data. An optional reply address lets the maintainer follow up.

Do **not** send passwords, access tokens, authentication/configuration files, browser profiles, private page contents or personal documents. If reproduction needs sensitive material, describe the situation first so a suitable follow-up can be arranged.

This public repository distributes documentation and application packages. Reports can concern the companion, extension, installer or published downloads. Start with the current [release candidate](https://github.com/Maharajahu/ToolBraid-Companion/releases/tag/v0.3.1-rc.1); older candidates are retained as historical releases. No response-time or long-term support guarantee is implied.

For ordinary bugs and feature requests, use the [public issue forms](https://github.com/Maharajahu/ToolBraid-Companion/issues/new/choose). Read the [data-handling policy](https://toolbraid.pages.dev/privacy/) and [known compatibility limits](../docs/compatibility.md) for context.
